record.question: Mandatory patient identification before imaging is:
options: Name, age, registration number and confirmation from the patient
record.explanation: Answer D: Name, age, registration number and confirmation from the patient. Positive identification should use multiple identifiers and active confirmation with the patient before imaging. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
